scripts.name: trainline_read_train_results
scripts.description: Extraction-only stage. Start on loaded https://www.thetrainline.com/book/results following search submission and driver observe/wait. Required inputs: origin,destination (city strings), date (YYYY-MM-DD), adults (integer), currency (ISO code). Validates displayed route/passengers and URL date; polls up to 10 seconds for loaded fares. Outputs matching-date train journeys with departure/arrival ISO local offsets, duration, changes, fares, currency and source URL. Next: present results; no purchase. Not yet replay-tested.

scripts.name: trainline_setup_one_adult_search
scripts.description: Start https://www.thetrainline.com/en-us with homepage form present. Required inputs origin,destination city strings; date absolute YYYY-MM-DD; adults integer (currently only 1 supported); locale string (only en-us supported); currency string (only USD supported). All validated before actions. No inferred route/date. Semantic defaults: one-way, depart after 00:00, no railcards; disables accommodation promotion. Resolves exact city or city (Any) from autocomplete; native setters and events; selects calendar date, verifies route/date/passenger/currency then submits. Output submitted flag and next-page condition. Navigation destroys evaluate context: driver must observe/wait for /book/results, then trainline_read_train_results with same inputs. Untested replay; unsupported passenger counts/locales/currencies fail rather than silently reusing form values.

What’s the best time to book?

Three months in advance! It’s when most carriers release their tickets (apart from Eurostar – look for Eurostar tickets six months in advance).

Want to get the best price for your journey? Book early. Prices normally go up closer to the departure date.

Plus, you might not get seats together if you book late (which might be a bonus for the introverts out there).

Can I plan a multi-city trip?

Yep! Search for one leg at a time, placing your tickets in the basket. Then go to checkout and pay all in one go.

How do I know when and where to board?

Grab our app. On the day of travel you'll get travel times, platforms, disruption info, and more.
